newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-CORRETJA THROUGH TO MARBELLA QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CORRETJA THROUGH TO MARBELLA QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: Alex Corretja's determination to avoid becoming another seed to flop in the Marbella world series tournament carried him to a 6-3 6-2 win over Belgium's Johan van Herck on Thursday.
Fourth seed Corretja set up a quarter-final clash with Marcelo Filippini of Uruguay who beat another qualifier, Argentina's Franco Squillari, in a deciding set tie-breaker. He won 5-7 6-3 7-6.
Another surprise winner was Marcos Aurelio Gorriz who beat fellow Spaniard Carlos Costa 7-5 6-4.
Gorriz had lost the final match of the qualifying competition but was included in the draw after another player withdrew because of injury.
Costa showed the effects of a stomach bug and let Gorriz back into the game after leading in both sets.
Gorriz will face Germany's Bernd Karbacher who followed up his first-round win over top seed Alberto Costa by coming from behind to beat Spaniard Galo Blanco 4-6 7-5 6-3.
